standards.title: Microgravity EVA Aerobic Capacity
standards.quote: Crewmembers shall maintain an in-mission VO2max at or above 32.9 ml/min/kg for missions with microgravity EVAs as determined by either direct or indirect measures.

standards.title: Extraterrestrial Surface EVA Aerobic Capacity
standards.quote: Crewmembers shall maintain an in-mission VO2max at or above 36.5 ml/min/kg for missions with extraterrestrial surface EVAs as determined by either direct or indirect measures.
standards.usedFor: Seuil rouge absolu VO₂max (sortie sur Mars)

standards.title: In-Mission Aerobic Capacity
standards.quote: The in-mission aerobic capacity shall be maintained, either through countermeasures or work performance, at or above 80% of the pre-mission capacity determined by either direct or indirect measures.

standards.title: In-Mission Bone Countermeasures
standards.quote: Countermeasures shall maintain bone mineral density of the hip and spine at or above 95% of pre-mission values and at or above 90% for the femoral neck.
standards.usedFor: Seuil rouge hanche / rachis (perte > 5 %), col du fémur (perte > 10 %)

standards.title: Career Space Permissible Exposure Limit for Spaceflight Radiation Exposure
standards.quote: An individual crewmember's total career effective radiation dose due to spaceflight radiation exposure shall be less than 600 mSv. This limit is universal for all ages and sexes.
standards.usedFor: Calque Exposition, information de mission (dose prévue 982 mSv)

standards.title: Crew Medical Officers
standards.quote: The program(s) shall train a minimum of two crewmembers per vehicle/platform as Crew Medical Officers (CMOs).
standards.usedFor: Routage : le CMO de bord décide quand la Terre est loin

standards.title: Crew Medical Officer Training
standards.quote: Crewmembers who have received a mission assignment as a Crew Medical Officer (CMO) shall be provided with detailed and specific medical training […]
standards.usedFor: Le CMO n'est pas forcément médecin (pitch)
standards.note: Citation tronquée par l'outil de lecture ; la formule « souvent, mais pas obligatoirement, médecin » de la fiche n'a pas été relue dans ce passage.

standards.title: Behavioral Health and Cognition
standards.quote: Pre-mission, in-mission, and post-mission crew behavioral health and crewmember cognitive status shall be within clinically accepted values […]

standards.title: Circadian entrainment / crew schedule
standards.quote: Crew schedule planning and operations shall be provided to include circadian entrainment […]

standards.title: Psychological/Behavioral Health Support
standards.quote: Programs shall implement psychological/behavioral health support programs for the crewmembers […]
standards.usedFor: Item « point psy » proposé, slide Vision

standards.title: Private Psychological Conference (PPC)
standards.quote: A PPC shall be scheduled on a routine basis, as determined by the Behavioral Health Provider […]
standards.usedFor: Point psy de routine avec le sol

standards.title: Crew Health Monitoring Records
standards.quote: The results of all crew health monitoring shall be kept in a permanent retrievable format […]

standards.title: Bisphosphonates (glossaire, annexe C)
standards.quote: A group of medicines that slows [down] or prevent bone loss, preserving bone strength.
standards.note: Seule mention dans la Rev C. L'affirmation de la fiche (« perte ramenée à ~0 % », « < 5 % avec l'ARED », attribuée à la justification de V1 4027) N'EST PAS dans la norme : source à trouver (étape 3).
